name: 李清照
foreign_name: Li Qingzhao（李清照，号易安居士，1084—约1155后）
summary: 李清照，济南人，'China's greatest woman poet'（中国最伟大的女诗人——Britannica），词人。'Came from a literary family and was writing praised poetry as a teenager'（文学世家、青少年即被赞——Britannica）；1101年嫁赵明诚（Britannica：Married antiquarian Zhao Mingcheng in 1101）；1129年夫亡南渡（Britannica：he died in 1129 during their flight from the Juchen takeover of Kaifeng）；1132年抵杭州、后逃金华（Britannica：Reached Hangzhou by 1132, then fled to Jinhua, Zhejiang, where she died）。'known for striking word choices and drawing on personal experience, giving her poems notable emotional intensity'（字句惊人、个人经验入诗、情感强度著称——Britannica）；'Wrote mainly ci poetry (a song form); her command of its metrical rules led her to produce one of the earliest scholarly studies of the form'（词学——Britannica）；'Produced seven volumes of essays and six of poetry, though most are lost'（七卷散文六卷诗多佚——Britannica）。'Earlier pieces show carefree vitality, while post-exile work carries a sombre, grieving quality'（前期活泼后期凄怆——Britannica）。

timeline.text: 生于济南（Britannica：Born in Jinan, Shandong province）；号易安居士（Britannica：her literary name was Yi'an Jushi）。
嫁赵明诚（Britannica：Married antiquarian Zhao Mingcheng in 1101）。
夫亡于南渡途中（Britannica：he died in 1129 during their flight）。
抵杭州后逃金华（Britannica：Reached Hangzhou by 1132, then fled to Jinhua）。
卒于金华（Britannica：where she died；'after 1155'——Britannica 卒年带'后'）。

style: '字句惊人'：Britannica——'known for striking word choices'（字句惊人著称——Britannica）。
'词学'：Britannica——'one of the earliest scholarly studies of the form'（最早词学研究之一——Britannica《词论》）。
'前期活泼后期凄怆'（Britannica：Earlier pieces show carefree vitality, while post-exile work carries a sombre, grieving quality——Britannica）。
status: Britannica 称李清照为'China's greatest woman poet'（中国最伟大的女诗人——Britannica）。'婉约派'代表（通说待核）；'宋词双璧'（与辛弃疾并称'济南二安'——通说待核）。
pending: 卒年'1155后'的精确年份（1156说——通说待核）待核。
《声声慢》'寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清'原文逐字核对。
《词论》的'词别是一家'论点待核。
王仲闻《李清照集校注》待核。
